global_organization_chain: Define equity and measure it as cross-country dispersion
Validate the rise in dispersion against history and an external report
Price one real asteroid and pass the profit through the equity model
Test throughput and participation, then write policy for each result

main_argument_chains.claim: Asteroid mining concentrated in a few countries widens global inequity, and broader participation narrows it.
support_steps: Score 205 countries on asset, achievement and group differences
Measure inequity by the coefficient of variation
Show the CV rose from 2000 to 2020
Select mining countries with a GE matrix
Price asteroid 2011UW-158 and sell under Cournot competition
Transmit the GDP gain through regressions
Show more entrants lower the CV
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Restrict private appropriation, encourage more countries to enter, and supervise the new space economy.
